_comment: Recordings excluded from aggregate and between-condition analysis. Each entry records the objective criterion that triggered exclusion so the decision is reproducible and auditable. Excluding a recording here removes it from every aggregate, per-condition export and comparison statistic. Set 'enabled' to false to re-include everything without deleting the rationale.

excluded.reason: Fixation-detection failure. The recording yields 107 fixations over 774 s (8.3/min) against a cohort median of 125.5/min, roughly twelve times below the lowest otherwise-normal recording. The underlying gaze stream is intact (193.6 Hz sampling, 100 percent AOI coverage), so this reflects a failure of the device fixation/saccade detector rather than participant behaviour. Any fixation-count or fixation-duration metric derived from this recording is invalid.
